nodes.name: Repository-local knowledge graph
nodes.summary: kgmaker is a custom, repository-local knowledge graph tool designed specifically for GitHub Copilot CLI.

nodes.name: Scoped compiler filesystem discovery
nodes.summary: TypeScript records bounded positive inputs and filesystem discovery; offline replay validates freshness without resolving modules or running processes.

nodes.name: Bounded static callback evidence
nodes.summary: TypeScript-selected signatures and canonical parameters preserve declared evidence while callback bindings and unions remain incomplete candidates, separate from runtime dispatch proof.

nodes.name: Explicit business process model
nodes.summary: Versioned revision-bound process documents compose shared technical view/evidence with a strictly separate semantic overlay; they do not discover or execute processes.

nodes.name: Source code is authoritative
nodes.summary: When documentation conflicts with code-derived facts, source code wins and contradictions remain report evidence.

nodes.name: Explicit workspace service ownership
nodes.summary: Workspace service ownership is assigned only by explicit repository roots or exact repo-qualified module IDs; ambiguity remains visible.

nodes.name: Explicit service inventory projection
nodes.summary: The T008 topology view composes explicit ownership with provider contexts; scoped SOURCE_ONLY roots remain PARTIAL with module coverage UNKNOWN.

nodes.name: View evidence and coverage
nodes.summary: Architecture view projections preserve evidence kind, resolution, freshness, explicit polarity and selected-scope coverage without ranking or inferring unknown evidence.

nodes.name: Realm-bound data resources
nodes.summary: Pure data-resource topology preserves explicit workspace/repository/database/stream identities, scoped upstream access facts, migration derivation and unknown runtime availability.

nodes.name: Scoped HTTP provider projection
nodes.summary: HTTP interfaces preserve explicit service identity, case-sensitive routes, registration/contract variants and source/context evidence without deployment/runtime promotion.

nodes.name: Optional agent-authored semantic layer
nodes.summary: The extraction workflow keeps agent-authored semantic relationships scoped and separate from deterministic graph extraction.

nodes.name: Compiler proven default and bridge declaration mapping
nodes.summary: Separate generated identities map to source declarations only with compatible compiler-proven staticness, exact signatures and bounded structural proof; missing ABI stays bytecode-only.

nodes.name: Kotlin JPA use-site access
nodes.summary: K2 compiler-resolved Kotlin annotation identity, use-site placement, and values select JPA access and mapping facts; ambiguous placement or unresolved explicit values remain diagnostic or UNKNOWN without invented physical bindings.

nodes.name: Repository entity owner resolution
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository models, JPQL entities, and query return projections resolve through exact compiler-qualified owners; bare source return names require a matching JVM descriptor, and missing or ambiguous identities remain unresolved without simple-name or repository-domain fallback.

nodes.name: Typed HTTP request and terminal intent
nodes.summary: Compiler-bound Java request origins separate cold definitions from same-origin static terminals; configuration provenance and privacy boundaries preserve UNKNOWN runtime availability.
